description: Source mutations for the public CadDocument replacement APIs. The two tests assert analytic rectangular-solid volumes, preserve names/types/structural sketch links, and guard feature indices before public-vector reads.

mutants.description: Replacing a feature with an edited payload name must retain the existing timeline identity; the test asserts the original name after the replacement.
Replacing an Extrude must retain its existing feature type even when the valid edited payload deliberately says Sketch; the type and 800 mm^3 recompute witnesses must reject the mutation.
An edited Extrude must retain its original sketch link; the test supplies an invalid payload link and requires the edited volume to recompute successfully.
The split replacement must transfer the edited extrusion distance to the Extrude slot; the test changes a 10x10x5 box to a 12x8x4 box and checks its analytic volume.
